chat.author: Evan Hunt
chat.text: I confess, the fact that BIND enforces LDH for hostnames got into my brain as a specifiation requirement rather than an implementation choice.  1035 does kind of imply it, though, by defining the word "host" in the context of rfc 921

chat.author: Evan Hunt
chat.text: I guess rfc 2181 relaxed that, but I thought the relaxation only applied to non-address records (i.e., not "hosts")

chat.text: It's not just CAB forum, but PKIX RFC 5280) also constrains the alphabet to LDH+_. However, if NS names are not being authenticated via PKIX (DANE?) maybe that restriction doesn't matter.
